get_working_directory.desc: Return the server's current working directory, OS/architecture, hostname, and a compact environment summary. Call this early when local path or OS assumptions matter; most tools default to this cwd.

run_command.desc: Run a bounded non-interactive shell command and return combined stdout/stderr. Use for project scripts, tests, build tools, version-control inspection, or local operations not covered by purpose-built tools. This is not a terminal: no PTY, no full-screen apps, and no interactive prompts unless scripted through stdin.

params.command: Command string executed by the selected shell. Keep it non-interactive; pass scripted input with stdin when needed.
params.cwd: Working directory for the command. Defaults to the server's current working directory.
params.timeout_seconds: Seconds before timeout. Default: 60; maximum: 600. Non-positive values use the default.
params.env: Extra environment variables as ["KEY=value", ...], merged with the current environment for this command only.
params.max_output_bytes: Maximum combined stdout/stderr bytes to return. Omitted default: 262144 (256 KB). Set explicitly to 0 for unlimited output.
params.stdin: String piped to standard input. Ignored when detach=true. Use for scripted prompts, not interactive TUIs.
params.shell: Shell wrapper: default, sh, bash, cmd, powershell, or pwsh. Default is cmd on Windows and sh elsewhere; choose powershell/pwsh for PowerShell syntax and bash/sh for Unix syntax.
params.allow_nonzero_exit: Return non-zero exit output as a normal result instead of a tool error. Default: false.
params.raw_output: Return only stdout/stderr without command/cwd/shell/exit metadata. Useful for parseable JSON or machine-readable command output. Default: false.
params.detach: Start a long-running process and return immediately with its PID. Output is not captured; timeout_seconds, stdin, and max_output_bytes are ignored. Default: false.

open_in_app.desc: Open a local file, directory, or URL in the user's default system application. Non-blocking; prefer this over shelling out to open/start/xdg-open.

params.target: File path, directory path, or URL to open.
params.app: Optional application name to use on macOS. Ignored on other platforms.

get_env.desc: Inspect environment variables without using the shell. With key, returns one variable; with filter, returns matching names; with neither, lists names only by default to avoid leaking secrets.

params.key: Exact variable name to inspect. Values are shown by default for key lookups unless include_values=false.
params.filter: Case-insensitive substring matched against variable names. Values are shown by default for filtered lookups unless include_values=false.
params.include_values: Include variable values. Default: true when key or filter is set, false when listing all variables.
params.limit: Maximum variables to show for list/filter modes. Default: 100; set 0 for all. Negative values use the default.
params.value_max_bytes: Maximum bytes per displayed value. Default: 4096; set 0 for full values. Negative values use the default.
params.redact_secrets: Redact values for secret-like names containing markers such as TOKEN, PASSWORD, API_KEY, SECRET, or AUTH. Default: true.
